description.value: Your loyal follower gives you sage advice and insight into the trustworthiness of others. Despite being a minion, your loyal follower gains 1 reaction at the start of its turns, which it can use only to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW] you on a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo] check or a Perception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]. Its very presence counts as preparation to Aid. It automatically succeeds at its check to Aid you with those skills, or automatically critically succeeds if you're a master of the skill in question.
